about_the_game:
Breakout Garage is an open world driving and racing simulator that takes place in Texas, USA. Featuring in depth car building system and various parts combinations for each vehicle making it more suitable for preferred driving style and types of races such as street drag racing, official drag racing, and oval racing.

Current content & features :

  • Simulator physics with toggleable driving aids such as traction control, anti-lock braking system, and electronic stability control to enhance your driving experience based on your preference.

  • Open-world gameplay with dynamic environment & weather system.

  • Peer-to-Peer multiplayer where you can host/join a server with an in-server race lobby system to challenge other players

  • Highly detailed cars with a wide range of performance and cosmetic customization.

  • First-Person mechanic mode.

  • Each part affects physics by weight, aerodynamics, center of mass, engine compression ratio, engine displacement, engine inertia, and much more! 

  • Simulated electrical load when starting cars, different types of bulbs (Halogen, LED, HID,...etc)

  • Simulated Engine thermodynamics and airflow,

  • Used car dealer where players can choose from an infinite number of randomly generated used cars and inspect each them before purchase.

  • Intelligent traffic system.

  • Wheel + shifter support.

  • accurate 1/4 mile and 1/8 mile drag racing with prep/no prep, standard tree or pro tree with leaderboards 

  • Realistic economy with realistic prices.

  • Photo-mode for capturing stunning in-game moments and sharing them with friends.

  • Engine swaps.

  • Wear and tear system as parts wear out with use and require repair or change with most parts giving an audible indicator such as lifter tick, rod knock, worn suspension parts,...etc.

  • Simple police & pursuit system with special maneuvers based on wanted level.

  • Restore and sell cars for a profit

  • In depth tire & wheel system to allow 3 types of wheel fitment (stretched, straight, and meaty tires)

  • Paint wear including faded paint, edge rust, and patina.

  • Decal system with interior & window stickers.

  • In-game wiki to help players learn more about game content till real life mechanics.

  • Over 12 real life aftermarket brands

  • Delivery job system with random deliveries & payouts depending on load, distance & delivery time.


Planned features & content :

  • A large and diverse map.

  • A highly diverse career with deliveries, drag racing, drift events, oval racing, and dirt racing.

  • More cars & engines.

  • More customization for each car

  • A junkyard in which players can buy an entire worn car or part out a car for cheap.
